space.name: Kitting Domain Layout 14
space.notes: The meta-planner test-bed's room with two robot-side additions (MPB part (v); analysis/mpb/coverage.md, authoring.md part (v)); the human's side is env_layout_12's, unchanged. (1) Cell D8, the switch against an admitted projection: shelf_11, 70 cm beyond shelf_5 on the robot's approach bearing from scenario_s10_02's start, and kitting_table_5, NE of it, placed so that the delivery shelf_11 -> kitting_table_5 is 2.5 ticks dearer on plain cost than item_7's crossing delivery at the robot's position at the admission (an authored parameter: the midpoint of (0, hold), fixed before any run). Needed because every alternative in env_layout_12 is at least 11.2 ticks dearer from shelf_5, above the crossing's hold. (2) Cell C2, the hold against an admitted standing segment: shelf_10 and kitting_table_6, whose carry runs west along y of about -555 and passes within min_separation of the human's waiting point at the coffee machine (-166, -580): 25.4 cm at its closest in the robot-alone run; needed because every robot station of env_layout_12 lies at y >= -220, so only a walk from the start can pass the waiting point, within 7.4 ticks of the start, before any admission of coffee_break is possible.
